channel.title: Rob Burbea — Practising the Jhānas (Unofficial)
channel.description: An unofficial personal feed assembled by Jake McCrary from Rob Burbea's Practising the Jhānas retreat recordings on Dharma Seed. This is not an official Rob Burbea or Dharma Seed publication. The complete series is ordered from 01 to 32; guided meditation episodes are marked [GUIDED]. Audio streams directly from Dharma Seed and is not rehosted or altered.
